title: Sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='0' y='62' width='100' height='9' rx='4' fill='#7a4f2a'/>
  <rect x='0' y='63' width='100' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9a6b3f'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#b08a5e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='61' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#d9b98c'/>

  <path d='M28 46 Q20 44 20 52 L20 62 Q20 66 25 66 Q29 66 29 62 L29 52 Q29 49 32 50 Z' fill='#9a7550'/>
  <path d='M22 62 L22 52 Q22 47 27 47' stroke='#c9a878' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm hooked over branch -->
  <path d='M72 46 Q80 44 80 52 L80 62 Q80 66 75 66 Q71 66 71 62 L71 52 Q71 49 68 50 Z' fill='#9a7550'/>
  <path d='M78 62 L78 52 Q78 47 73 47' stroke='#c9a878' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='72' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#9a7550'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='72' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#9a7550'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='17' fill='#c19a6b'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#ecd9b8'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='35' rx='6' ry='5.5' fill='#4a3a52'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='35' rx='6' ry='5.5' fill='#4a3a52'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='2.6' fill='#1c1420'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='2.6' fill='#1c1420'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='1' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='1' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#3a2a44'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 46 Q50 50 55 46' stroke='#7a5a3a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='33' r='4' fill='#a8825a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='33' r='4' fill='#a8825a'/>
</svg>
